They carry the whole paraphrase (shoe = 自然, what is so of itself; Canons = tracks of one who leaves things to their true nature) with no drift; the locator is right since Giles 14.132 holds both lines. Plain sense matches day.js 14.131 to 14.132 (Confucius used the Six Canons with seventy-two rulers, none adopted them; Lao Tzŭ calls them worn-out foot-prints) and does not repeat the key. verse.js ok (Zhuangzi 14.132, at 1376); entry-check.js ok, no errors or warns. No school needed, no comparison, tone neutral.
